decisions.reason: As a flagship biodynamic range with visible multi-year commitment and central to the announced direction, escalation makes dropping unlikely despite any soft results.
With only a product page and no flagship commitment, there is less sunk-cost justification, but the firm is still likely to keep it absent clear failure.
Like B, it has limited public commitment and investment, so the probability of dropping is moderate if results disappoint, but no evidence yet forces exit.
